A vendor demoed an agent to our sales team last week that "handles objections in real time."

The first objection was price. The agent offered a discount. The second objection was price again. The agent offered a bigger discount. Our VP of Sales, who was playing the customer, said "price" a third time to see what would happen.

The agent offered 40% off and a free onboarding package we do not sell.

The vendor's rep said this was configurable. The VP asked what the default was. The default was 40%.

We are not buying it. We did ask if we could keep the transcript.
